148:t_033:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「You're telling me to abandon $$トウキョウ$$...?!」

148:t_033:5.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But if we keep fighting, we'll be driven into a position where even retreat is impossible!」

148:t_033:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you can't make up your minds, I'll give you a reason.」

148:t_034:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Lord $$バルビエル$$. $$サルディアス・アクス$$ has returned.」

148:t_034:3.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We... can't win against this!」

148:t_034:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't give up! If we retreat here, $$新日本$$ is finished!」

148:t_034:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, you wretches of $$新日本$$! I'll show you the moment the invincible $$ゼロ$$ admits defeat!」

148:t_034:13.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Take your fight to the world! Those of us who remain will defend $$新日本$$!」

148:t_035:1.en:
$$藤堂$$
「$$新日本$$'s soul will never die, as long as you remain its hope!」

148:t_035:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How brave. But faced with overwhelming power, you won't be able to spout such pretty words!」

148:t_035:5.en:
$$藤堂$$
「This country will rise again and again! Even if you burn our cities, our souls will never die!」

148:t_035:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then as you wish, I'll turn this city to ashes, along with you and $c!」

148:t_035:7.en:
$$藤堂$$
「If the likes of you are going to do it, I'd rather do it myself!」

148:t_035:9.en:
$$藤堂$$
「$$玉城$$! Use our trump card!!」

148:t_035:11.en:
$$玉城$$
「I believe you'll win in the end, no matter what!!」

148:t_035:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, get away from the elevated structure!!」

148:t_036:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then $$トウキョウ$$ will...!」

148:t_036:2.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We won't give you anything, neither $$トウキョウ$$ nor our pride!!」

148:t_036:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, fall back! Hurry!!」

148:t_037:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「We'll definitely come back to reclaim $$新日本$$ from them!」

148:t_037:2.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...! The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...!」

148:t_037:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Remember this! I'll repay you for today!」

148:t_037:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I swear it on the name of $$ゼロ$$!」

148:t_038:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「H-how could this happen...?! My chance to redeem myself...!」

148:t_038:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fall back...! We must endure the unendurable, bear the unbearable, and wait for another chance!」

148:t_039:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「A small fry who talks too much is a pathetic sight.」

148:t_039:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No matter how many times he comes back, we'll just beat him again...!」

148:t_040:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「H-how could this happen...?! I've made such a disgrace of myself before that person!」

148:t_040:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fall back...! We must endure the unendurable, bear the unbearable, and wait for another chance!」

148:t_041:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Nobody's listening to a word you say.」

148:t_041:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Sorry, but we don't have time to waste on small fry.」

148:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Just you wait, $$サルディアス$$...! I'll clear my name here, and someday I'll take your position...!)

148:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
($c...! To do that, I'll use you as my stepping stone!)

148:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh...! You're the Captain $$アムロ・レイ$$ I've heard so much about!」

148:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course I do...! Your role is far more important than you imagine.」

148:t_101:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither Earth nor I have time to indulge such nonsense...!」

148:t_101:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm simply a soldier, fighting to liberate Earth!」

148:t_102:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my... You're quite skilled. A talent like yours is rare even across the galaxy.」

148:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is he... just playing around...?!」

148:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I haven't the slightest room to play around against a first-rate opponent like you.」

148:t_102:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I seem relaxed, that must be the wisdom of age.」

148:t_102:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's dangerous to let him set the pace...! This man is more than a mere joker!」

148:t_102:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... Thank you for thinking so highly of me.」

148:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Here's another unusual machine...! This planet is like a jack-in-the-box!」

148:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is he talking about the $$ユニコーン$$...?!」

148:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As I thought, you're unaware. You people should learn a little more about what makes you so unusual.」

148:t_103:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And while you're at it, please hurry up and accept that resisting is pointless.」

148:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't fall for your words! As long as there's any chance left, I'll fight with all my strength!」

148:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my... Are you the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about?」

148:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Despite appearances, I have quite a few connections with $$リアクター$$s...」

148:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Even in this vast galaxy, I may be the only person who's actually met so many $$リアクター$$s.」

148:t_104:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how frightening. Fearless youth really is a frightening thing.」

148:t_104:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you still can't use your $$スフィア$$ properly at all, it seems. That's a relief.」

148:t_104:7.en:
$n
「What do you know about my $$スフィア$$?! I'll shut that glib mouth of yours!」

148:t_105:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... Even the famous $$ゼロ$$ lacks his usual edge today. Our efforts to shake you have clearly been effective.」

148:t_105:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You are indeed an able commander. But I feel no desire to respect you.」

148:t_105:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for your generous praise. Getting those words out of the famous $$ゼロ$$ will add some luster to my career.」
